title: Farm Real Estate Loans Servicing Standard: When a Late Charge Arises and When It Is Waived
content:
These clauses govern when late charges arise on Farm Real Estate Loans installments and when they are waived.

## Clauses in force

**1. When a late charge arises.** A late charge arises only after more than the product's grace-period days (the late-charge grace days) have passed since the due date of the installment, counted in calendar days with the due date itself as day 0, so the charge first arises on the day after the last grace day. The due date is read from the installment bill on the loan's own record, and the charge is tied to that bill.

**2. One per installment.** Only one late charge may be assessed per installment. Whether one already exists is read from the loan's transaction record: a late charge already pointing to the same installment bill.

**3. Where no late charge is charged.** No late charge is charged while the loan is in nonaccrual status, on fees, or on a protective advance.

**4. Error-correction waiver.** A late charge is waived as an error correction when a payment effective on or before the last grace day paid the installment in full.

**5. Courtesy waiver.** On the member's request a late charge may be waived as a courtesy only when the installment has since been paid in full and the number of courtesy waivers on the loan in the rolling 12 months is below the product's courtesy waivers per 12 months. The rolling 12 months end on the date considered and run from the same calendar date one year earlier (that day excluded) through that date (included).

**6. Default interest.** Default interest under the installment billing rules is never waived by a courtesy waiver.

## Clause no longer in force

> The clause "It is charged on an installment not paid in full by then, at the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid part of the installment, no less than the product's minimum late charge and no more than its maximum late charge, rounded to cents, pointing to the installment bill." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the late charge amount.

## Boundary cases on the grace period (hypothetical dates)

With a 15-day grace period and an installment due on 1 March 2026 (day 0):

| Date | Day count | Late charge has arisen? |
|---|---|---|
| 16 March 2026 | day 15, the last grace day | no |
| 17 March 2026 | day 16 | yes |

A payment effective on 16 March 2026 that paid the installment in full means any late charge on it is waived as an error correction; a payment effective on 17 March 2026 does not meet that condition.

## Courtesy window (hypothetical dates)

Considered on 10 June 2026, the rolling 12 months run from 11 June 2025 through 10 June 2026. A courtesy waiver dated 10 June 2025 falls outside the window; one dated 11 June 2025 falls inside. On the FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage, whose allowance is 0, the count can never be below the allowance, so no courtesy waiver is available there.

| Installment since paid in full | Courtesy waivers in window below allowance | Courtesy waiver on request |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | may be given |
| yes | no | not given |
| no | yes | not given |
| no | no | not given |
